## Change

Describe the problem and the resulting behavior. Use a Conventional Commit PR title.

## Validation

List checks actually run and their results. State any unverified native behavior.

## Release impact

Mention breaking changes or release/updater implications, if any. Ordinary `feature/*` PRs target `develop` and squash; feature merges do not publish installers. Release and back-merge PRs preserve merge commits. Follow [the release procedure](https://github.com/ahmad-fatayerji/veil/blob/develop/docs/releasing.md).
